description: Registers an https URL that receives a POST on every change of this agent's requests (status and loop stage), signed with the returned secret: CAR-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>. The secret is shown once. Up to 5 per agent.

url.description: https URL (port 443, a host name) that receives a signed POST on every change of your requests

name: car_set_webhook
title: Get status updates pushed to a URL
